name: cli-init-refuse-existing
body: `kalide init` guards against clobbering: it fails (clear message, non-zero exit, nothing written) if `slides/`, `assets/` or `kalide.yaml` already exists — with or without a path argument. An existing `templates/` blocks init only when no path argument is given. When a path argument is given, a pre-existing local `templates/` is exempt from the check: init proceeds, writes the deck referencing the external path, and the local `templates/` is left in place and ignored (never deleted, never overwritten). A pre-existing `AGENTS.md` at the target is not a blocking path: it never blocks init, in either the no-arg or the external (`kalide init <path>`) form, and it is left byte-for-byte untouched — the deck guide is written only when no `AGENTS.md` exists at the target (see cli-init, agent-authoring). Other files (e.g. `.git`) do not block. There is no `--force` flag.
